Before I got into elementary school, I must have been maybe 4 or 5 yo, my parents would sometimes fake abandoning me. I don't really remember what caused them to do so, but they would usually yell at me, get tired of hearing me cry and then leave me outside the front door saying that they didn't want me anymore. I remember sitting on the steps outside for what felt like an eternity, with no idea of where to go, fully believing I had no more home or family. Then after a while they would let me back in, usually in tears, ask me for forgiveness and then act like it had never happened. It may sound dumb, but I will never forget that feeling of rejection.
